reason: Prototype pollution in mergeDeep, used while building the schema from our own type definitions, never on request data. The fix needs @nestjs/graphql 14 and @nestjs/apollo 14, a major upgrade tracked as INF-21.

Prototype pollution in mergeIncrementalResult, which merges @defer/@stream results inside graphql-tools executors. We run none (no @graphql-tools/executor, delegate or stitch), so it is never called. @nestjs/graphql 13 pins utils 12.0.0; the fix comes with @nestjs/graphql 14 (INF-21).

Denial of service through trailing bytes after a compressed request body. Fixed in 2.4.0, released 2026-10-22, too new to install before 2026-11-05. Then run npm update body-parser and remove this entry (INF-22).

Denial of service while an asynchronous fileFilter is pending at request teardown. Our only fileFilters (gateway image uploads) are synchronous. Fixed in 2.5.0, released 2026-10-22; @nestjs/platform-express 11 still pins 2.4.0. After 2026-11-05, override multer to 2.5.0 and remove this entry (INF-22).
